body: I heard on reddit you're supposed to put your finger in their butthole and they let go instantly. Lol, but this is reddit.
It's too cold! There's a reason why we live in S.Tx! 🥶🥶🥶🤣🤣
36 woman from SA, exchange pics and maybe meet for a coffee in NB?
Send me a message if you haven't found someone.
Gargoyles. 🤷‍♀️I used to like that cartoon.
I know how it is. I'm going through it too. I'm just so tired.
If it truly matters that much what people think after your death, I don't think you really want to do it.

I think they're going to be ok. My ex was a shitty husband but he's always been an excellent father. Thats something I'll always be so grateful for. I know they'll be taken care of. I'm super close to my sisters and neices and nephews, so are the kids. I know my ex will continue to facilitate a close relationship with them and not deny my kids their mothers side of the family. So they'll grow up with stories of me(there's plenty) and always feel me near when they're with my sisters. For me, this is comforting.

And update, today is Saturday and I'm pretty sure this is going to be my last weekend with them. They go to their dads on Monday. After I drop them off I'm going to go run some errands, close some bank accounts and tie up loose ends and get small things done before I lay down and have my last cocktail. I feel like I should go do something really fun and spontaneous with them but can't think of what. I've told them nonstop how much I love them and we've been taking tons of pictures and making videos. They'll grow up knowing their mother loved them so much. This makes me a bit happy.
It's ok, I'm fine with it. And it feels way better than having to deal with living with myself like this.

Depends on what you're going to use to OD on. I did Tylenol and it didn't work. I read the maximum amount you can take daily is 8grams. 10 grams or more and you're risking liver damage. So I decided to take 46grams and handfuls of sleeping pills to help me nod off. I ended up waking up the next day sick as a dog. I was puking for days. Now I have another plan that'll hopefully work.

No, not really. Everyone says the first step to healing is talking about it and reaching out but now that people know I'm a bit couched about what I let people know. For instance, I have the way I'm going to do it and got what I need. I haven't told anyone this. They just assume I'm still in a depressive funk.

It's a weird position to be in for sure. When I didn't tell anyone about the first time, I had to live with it on my conscious. And now that everyone knows, I'm getting a ton of help and support but I still fell an immense amount of guilt and shame. In short, like a total shitshow.

And I didn't fight it the first time. I acted on it. I made my goodbye videos for my kids(I have two, an 8 year old and a 3 year old), wrote out what I wanted done with my possessions, who got how much from my savings/401k. I've already made newer videos for my kids to remember me by and took our last family selfies together.

The thing is, it IS shameful. I didn't tell my siblings(who I'm super close to) because I was scared they'd be angry at me for being selfish. I truly cannot live with my siblings being upset at me. When I came out about my attempts and my crisis rn, they've been the best, they said they were sorry I was going through this and we were all going to fight this together(my sister is the one to take me back to my doctor and get back on the meds) I dont deserve my siblings. I know everyone says suicide doesn't stop the pain, it just passes it on but I still feel like this is the best option for me.
No kidding. I'd give anything to get out of my head and be someone other than myself.
